method: Same-state constitutive audit followed by independently free-running correlation variants
notes: EP exterior h and radiation coefficients use the preceding zone-timestep surface temperature.
EP source uses 7.238 in unstable natural convection, while its 22.2 Engineering Reference prints 7.283.
RMS decomposition components do not add; biases do. Temperature-feedback term also includes the GraphBEM 30s explicit radiation lag.
Changing sky split is a model-choice sensitivity, not proof that isotropic sky is an implementation error.
Correlation variants retain GraphBEM time integration and enclosure radiation. They do not reproduce EP time integration exactly.
